newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel troops kill Arab boy, wound 17 in clashes.
newsitem.headline: Israel troops kill Arab boy, wound 17 in clashes.

text.p: Israeli troops shot dead a Palestinian youth on Wednesday during a clash with Arab stone-throwers near a Jewish settlement in the self-ruled Gaza Strip, Palestinian hospital officials said.

In the West Bank town of Hebron, soldiers shot and wounded 17 Palestinians. The troops used live ammunition and rubber bullets to disperse demonstrators hurling stones and petrol bombs, witnesses said.
"Maher al-Assar, 16, of Deir el-Balah arrived at Shifa hospital at 1 p.m. (1000 GMT) dead as a result of being shot with live ammunition in the chest," said Dr. Moawia Hasanein of Shifa hospital.
He said soldiers shot the boy at a protest near Gush Katif settlement in a dispute between Jewish settlers and Palestinians over a piece of land.
Witnesses said the Israeli army declared the area a closed military zone after troops fired bullets, tear gas and stun grenades to disperse the protesters.

Israeli troops have clashed with Palestinian protesters almost daily since Israel's groundbreaking of a Jewish settlement in Arab East Jerusalem last March plunged peacemaking with the PLO into crisis.
